description:
KVK detail

Returns the main establishment of a KVK number as a flat object: name,
legal form, address, RSIN, branch number and active status. Local cache
(48 hours) serves repeated requests.

Pass `geo=true` to add a `geo` object with the WGS84 coordinates and BAG
identifiers of the address (resolved via the BAG). `geo` is `null` when
the address cannot be matched to a BAG object.

Insolvency flags come from the Centraal Insolventieregister (CIR) and
only cover legal entities registered under this KVK number:
- `insolventieGevonden`: at least one insolvency case is registered.
- `surseanceGevonden`: at least one case is a suspension of payments.
- `schuldsaneringGevonden`: at least one case is a debt restructuring.
- `isBeeindigd`: all registered cases have ended (`false` when at least
  one case is still ongoing, `null` when no case is found).

A bankruptcy is a case that is neither `surseance` nor `schuldsanering`.
All flags are `null` when the CIR could not be reached. The CIR keeps
ended cases visible for up to 6 months. `insolventie` holds the case
details (`soort`, `beeindigd`, `beeindigdOp`, latest event) and is `null`
when no case is found. CIR results are cached for 6 hours.

Cost: 0.5 credit(s) per call. An API key is required via the X-Api-Key header (or Authorization: Bearer <key>); a per-call wallet payment via x402 is also accepted.

geo.description: Include BAG geo data (coordinates and BAG identifiers) for the address (default false).

name: kvk.detail
